slides: Your next PR isn’t about weight, it’s about control.

When control drops, the joint takes the load.

Choosing the stairs over the elevator adds minutes.

Training is the half; sleep is the other half.
During deep sleep, growth hormone spikes.
That spike repairs muscle fibers and synapses.
Skip sleep and you train on broken equipment.
Prioritize 7‑9 hours; your gains depend on it.

Consistent alignment trims wasted effort.
Live by the agenda you truly believe in.
